Enhanced Bolt Pistol Ammunition & Demolition Force 2026-10-01

Overview Updates (9) Reviews (3) History
  • 20261001234013_1.jpg
    274.2 KB · Views: 123
  • 20261001234007_1.jpg
    316.3 KB · Views: 122
It can now destroy bug holes, its damage has been slightly increased, and thanks to the blessings of the STC, programmable ammunition has been introduced, allowing you to switch between different ammo types.

Bolt Pistol Changes​

This mod improves the Bolt Pistol and introduces programmable ammunition while keeping its overall behavior close to the original weapon.

Direct Hit

  • Damage: 325 → 400
  • Durable Damage: 115 → 250
  • DemoForce: 20 → 30
Explosion

  • Explosion Damage: 175 (unchanged)
  • Explosion Durable Damage: 175 (unchanged)
  • Explosion DemoForce: 10 → 30
The increased DemoForce allows the Bolt Pistol to destroy Bug Holes when firing directly into the opening.

Ammunition

  • Starting Spare Magazines: 3 → 8
  • Maximum Spare Magazines: 4 → 8
  • Magazine Capacity: 6 rounds (unchanged)
Programmable Ammunition
Thanks to the blessings of the STC, the Bolt Pistol can now switch between three ammunition types:

  • Normal – Standard Bolt ammunition
  • Inferno – Incendiary ammunition that ignites and burns targets
  • Tempest – Specialized ammunition that applies a stun effect (no demoforce, non explode)
Ammo types can be cycled through the R-key menu:

Normal → Inferno → Tempest → Normal
Version 2.0 based https://ayakamods.com/mods/evictor-...ator-shells-new-arctic-shells-he-shells.4386/

Thanks to tarkavash

If you don’t like the changes introduced by the programmable ammunition system, you can use Version 1.7 instead,

Choose either the Enhanced Version or the Only DemoForce Version, (1.7v) depending on which changes you prefer.
